findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "request_quote" is 685 chars, far longer than this server's median (111). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, get_page · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, get_page · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
